references.text: The Lord says to Moses: 'Do not be afraid of him,' the same formulation about not fearing the enemy because the Lord gives victory
The promise that the Lord will give the kings of the enemies into Israel's hand, and that no one will be able to stand against them
Exhortation not to fear the enemy in war, because the Lord goes with his people
The Lord's promise to Joshua that no one will be able to stand against him all his days
The Lord commands Joshua not to fear, for the Lord is with him
The Lord tells Joshua not to fear and that he has given the king of Ai into his hand
The Lord repeats the promise to give the enemies into Israel's hand and that they should not fear
The Lord says to Moses: 'Do not be afraid of him, for I have given him into your hand' regarding King Og
The Lord's assurance: 'Do not be afraid, for I am with you,' the same theme of divine protection
